extension.description: Opt-in review of pinned Salesforce CLI sf data create, update, delete, export and bulk job resume routes; blocks hard delete. It does not resolve the target org or mediate provider execution.
extension.name: Salesforce sf data command risk rules

permissions.description: Reviews sf data record and bulk deletes, including legacy force:data aliases.
permissions.example_command: sf data delete bulk --sobject Account --file ids.csv
permissions.label: Salesforce record delete
safer_guidance: Review the target org, object, record set or query, and job ID before confirming.

permissions.description: Reviews sf data record updates and bulk update or upsert jobs.
permissions.example_command: sf data update bulk --sobject Account --file rows.csv
permissions.label: Salesforce record update
safer_guidance: Review the target org, object, record set or query, and job ID before confirming.

permissions.description: Reviews sf data record, file and bulk or tree imports that create records.
permissions.example_command: sf data import bulk --sobject Account --file rows.csv
permissions.label: Salesforce record create
safer_guidance: Review the target org, object, record set or query, and job ID before confirming.

permissions.description: Reviews sf data bulk and tree exports and bulk result downloads.
permissions.example_command: sf data export bulk --query 'SELECT Id FROM Contact' --output-file contacts.csv
permissions.label: Salesforce bulk export
safer_guidance: Review the target org, object, record set or query, and job ID before confirming.

permissions.description: Reviews sf data bulk job resumes that name an explicit job ID.
permissions.label: Salesforce bulk job resume
safer_guidance: Review the target org, object, record set or query, and job ID before confirming.

permissions.description: Blocks sf data bulk hard deletes, and bulk deletes whose flags come from a --flags-dir directory that could add --hard-delete.
permissions.example_command: sf data delete bulk --sobject Account --file ids.csv --hard-delete
permissions.label: Salesforce hard delete
safer_guidance: Review the target org, object, record set or query, and job ID before confirming.

permissions.description: Blocks sf data bulk job resumes without a stable job ID: --use-most-recent, or a --flags-dir directory that could supply it, can attach an earlier decision to a different job.
permissions.label: Salesforce unbound job resume
safer_guidance: Review the target org, object, record set or query, and job ID before confirming.
